themeDescription: Spaced repetition, connecting ideas, building knowledge

days.title: How Memory Works - Encoding, Storage, Retrieval
days.learning_objective: Understand the three stages of memory—encoding, storage, and retrieval—and how to optimize each.

days.title: Why We Forget - Forgetting Is Natural and Useful
days.learning_objective: Recognize that forgetting is a normal brain function that helps filter important from unimportant information.

days.title: Spaced Repetition - The Timing of Review
days.learning_objective: Learn how spacing out review sessions dramatically improves long-term retention compared to cramming.

days.title: Active Recall - Testing Yourself to Learn
days.learning_objective: Discover that actively retrieving information (testing yourself) is more effective than passive review.

days.title: Connecting Ideas - Networks of Knowledge
days.learning_objective: Understand that learning is strengthened by connecting new ideas to existing knowledge networks.

days.title: Prior Knowledge - Building on What You Know
days.learning_objective: Learn to activate and leverage existing knowledge when learning something new.

days.title: Chunking - Organizing Information
days.learning_objective: Master the technique of grouping individual pieces of information into meaningful chunks for easier memory.

days.title: Mnemonics - Memory Tricks and Tools
days.learning_objective: Learn memory techniques like acronyms, method of loci, and memory palaces to enhance recall.

days.title: Visual Memory - Learning Through Images
days.learning_objective: Harness the power of visual memory by creating mental images and diagrams to remember information.

days.title: Narrative Memory - Learning Through Stories
days.learning_objective: Use storytelling and narrative structure to make information more memorable and meaningful.

days.title: Embodied Memory - Learning Through Doing
days.learning_objective: Recognize that physical practice and hands-on learning create stronger, more durable memories.

days.title: Emotional Memory - Feelings Help Us Remember
days.learning_objective: Understand how emotions enhance memory and how to create positive emotional associations with learning.

days.title: Sleep and Learning - Rest Consolidates Memory
days.learning_objective: Learn how sleep is essential for memory consolidation and why all-nighters hurt learning.

days.title: Exercise and Learning - Movement Helps the Brain
days.learning_objective: Discover the connection between physical activity and cognitive function, including memory and learning.

days.title: Attention and Learning - Focus Determines What Sticks
days.learning_objective: Recognize that attention is the gateway to memory—what you don't attend to, you can't remember.

days.title: Distraction and Learning - The Cost of Divided Attention
days.learning_objective: Understand the real cognitive cost of multitasking and distraction on learning and memory.

days.title: Deep Work - Focused Learning Sessions
days.learning_objective: Practice deep work—extended periods of focused, distraction-free learning for complex material.

days.title: Shallow Work - Quick Learning Tasks
days.learning_objective: Recognize when quick, surface-level learning is appropriate and how to be efficient with it.

days.title: Learning Goals - What Do You Want to Remember?
days.learning_objective: Set clear learning goals that guide what to focus on and what to let go.

days.title: Learning Plans - Structuring Your Learning
days.learning_objective: Create effective learning plans that incorporate spacing, retrieval, and connection.

days.title: Learning Habits - Daily Practices That Compound
days.learning_objective: Build daily learning habits that compound over time into significant knowledge gains.

days.title: Learning Environment - Setting Up for Success
days.learning_objective: Design your physical and digital environment to support focused, effective learning.

days.title: Learning Partners - Studying with Others
days.learning_objective: Leverage the benefits of social learning through study partners and learning communities.

days.title: Teaching to Learn - The Best Way to Understand
days.learning_objective: Experience how teaching others is one of the most powerful ways to deepen your own understanding.

days.title: Applying Knowledge - Use It or Lose It
days.learning_objective: Understand that application and practice are essential for maintaining and deepening knowledge.

days.title: Transferring Skills - Using Learning in New Contexts
days.learning_objective: Develop the ability to transfer learning from one context to new, different situations.

days.title: Long-Term Learning - Building Lasting Knowledge
days.learning_objective: Focus on strategies that create lasting knowledge rather than short-term cramming.

days.title: AI as Memory Partner - Using AI to Support Recall
days.learning_objective: Learn how to use AI appropriately to support memory without replacing the learning process.

days.title: Month in Review - The Science of Learning
days.learning_objective: Synthesize the month's evidence-based learning strategies into personal practice.

days.title: Your Learning System - Design Your Personal Approach
days.learning_objective: Create a personalized learning system incorporating the most effective techniques for your style.
